NousResearch/hermes-agent#76616.blurb: Adds safe current-backend restart for Hermes Desktop across local and SSH backends, with active-turn confirmation, bounded teardown, ownership-verified process handling, fresh spawn identity, and reconnect; remote/cloud backends remain reconnect-only.

garrytan/gbrain#3776.blurb: Restores semantic takes retrieval by embedding active claims, wiring query vectors into think, and aligning vector dimensions with the configured embedder.

stablyai/orca#12139.blurb: Fixes cross-repository GitHub work-item pagination in Orca's Tasks view: compatible repository selections now use one Search API plan, merge results by creation time, preserve globally ordered pagination, and keep exact counts while retaining safe fallbacks.

garrytan/gbrain#3832.blurb: Fixes gbrain autopilot on Windows: resolves the CLI shim by walking PATH directly instead of the which command, with guards against cwd hijack, non-spawnable PATHEXT types, and directory shadowing.
